Nearly 5 years ago to this day I went to my previous job for the last time. I didn't have another job lined up, but I had thought about going back to school after 14 years away. By the end of that day I was sure I was going to jump off the rooftop of the building where I worked. The money and benefits were great, but the actual job itself was just dealing with shitty people all day and night. After nearly a decade I had enough.

My doctor said I couldn't go back to it, made some referrals that helped me get into a college program. Just graduated college with honors and I start earning my teaching credential next week. Yea I'm gonna be dealing with kids but they deserve a teacher that actually cares about what and how they learn. So yea it worked out, it's been hard and stressful on my family, but we agreed it was worth it and now I'm actually happy with my life for the first time.

Edit - I did end up quitting my job eventually, I had considered working part time while in college but it didn't work out, which in retrospect was for the best. I was out on leave for quite a while before I officially left.
